tailoring.headline: Full Stack Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert with 5+ Years in Java & Spring
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, I design and implement data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM, optimise SQL performance and lead CI/CD deployments on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2). I work techno-functionally, translating business requirements into robust, scalable commerce features and supporting production globally.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: REPA GROUP Full Stack Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited to apply for the Full Stack Developer role at REPA GROUP because of your commitment to innovative e-commerce solutions. With over five years of hands-on experience building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring and headless APIs that align perfectly with your needs.

bullets.label: **SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, covering product catalog, pricing and customer data, ensuring scalable commerce functionality.

bullets.label: **API Development & Integration**
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, streamlining data flows across global channels.

bullets.label: **CI/CD and Cloud Deployments**
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Jenkins and Docker, enabling rapid, reliable releases and production support.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Business Collaboration**
bullets.text: Working closely with international stakeholders, I translated business requirements into user stories and functional specs, delivering solutions that meet both technical and commercial goals.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: REPA GROUP’s focus on delivering cutting-edge e-commerce platforms and its emphasis on SAP Commerce Cloud aligns with my professional passion for building scalable, headless commerce solutions. I admire your commitment to leveraging modern technologies to enhance customer experiences, and I am eager to contribute my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to accelerate your projects and drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join REPA GROUP to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to your innovative e-commerce projects, delivering robust, scalable solutions that enhance customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about REPA GROUP’s Full Stack Developer role and would love to discuss how my Java, Spring and API integration experience can add value.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SAP Commerce Cloud environment, implementing OCC/Spartacus integrations and optimizing PIM-ERP data pipelines. I will also ensure smooth CI/CD deployments on CCv2 and provide proactive production support to maintain high availability.
tailoring.insight: The posting highlights SAP Commerce Cloud as a core requirement, indicating REPA GROUP’s focus on robust e-commerce platforms. My extensive experience with SAP Commerce Cloud will help accelerate your development roadmap.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Full Stack Developer – REPA GROUP
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. REPA GROUP’s commitment to innovative e-commerce solutions and its focus on SAP Commerce Cloud resonates with my expertise. I can deliver robust headless APIs, streamline PIM-ERP integrations, and enhance CI/CD pipelines to boost platform performance. I also note your interest in optional languages, and my strong SAP Commerce background will immediately add value. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
